floor_history.headline: Recon: floor=9 reconfirmed on pin-free candidate; m2c shows target reconstructs WITHOUT a load-temp (direct inlined stores) and WITHOUT the v1 pointer alias — an untried structural shape; sibling func

Structural sweep (13 forms). Floor held at 9; killed 8 named structural levers; walking-pointer lowers score to 7 but adds an insn so it's architecturally blocked from match — proves the RA tiebreak I

frontier.hypothesis: A cheat-free lever exists that reproduces output-30-1's load-temp->$v0 flip WITHOUT the invented dual-purpose variable and WITHOUT displacing the mask off $v1 -- i.e. that simultaneously pins load-temp=$v0 and mask=$v1 as target does.
frontier.mechanism: output-30-1 proved the load side CAN be forced to $v0; the residual is purely the mask landing on $a0 instead of $v1 (plus a pre-call halfword regression). The question is what cheat-free C structure gives the load web $v0 while leaving the 2-insn mask pseudo in $v1 -- the exact allocation the $3 pin forces by fiat.
frontier.next_probe: Instrumented cc1 .greg dump (BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG / -da) on BOTH the V7 floor-6 form AND output-30-1, comparing allocno priority ordering of the load web vs mask vs pre-call-halfword pseudos. Identify which pseudo GCC hands $v0 first and why the mask never gets $v1 when the load side wins $v0. Then search for a cheat-free C shape (statement geometry, not an invented carrier) that produces the target 3-way assignment.

frontier.hypothesis: The pre-call arg1+2 halfword regression to $a0 in output-30-1 is avoidable, isolating the mask-register problem.
frontier.mechanism: output-30-1 coupled the load-flip with a pre-call regression because the reused carrier stole $a0 from the halfword. A form that flips the load side to $v0 without touching the pre-call region would leave only the 3 mask-register diffs, a cleaner target for a subsequent lever.
frontier.next_probe: Directed-PERM (PERM_LINESWAP over the post-call cluster only, pre-call frozen byte-identical) seeded from a form that keeps the mask store interleaved but reshapes ONLY the load side, measuring whether the load->$v0 flip is reachable without a pre-call carrier.

frontier.hypothesis: Sibling triangulation (func_80061250 mask=0xFF0060 / func_80061658 mask=0x10FFFF, identical $2/$3 pin shape) would show whether the 3-way register wall is family-universal or constant-specific -- but is OUT OF THIS SESSION'S SCOPE (contract: work ONLY func_800611A4).
frontier.mechanism: All three siblings share the post-call mask/load cadence and the same pin cheat. A lever that closes the 3-way assignment on one likely closes the family; a future cross-function session (or owner ruling) could triangulate.
frontier.next_probe: A future session authorized for the family should apply the load->$v0 lever candidates to a sibling in a scratch sandbox and measure whether the mask-displacement behaves identically across mask constants.
